researcher_notes: CONFLICT RESOLUTION for DL-2026-08-21-1006. Glasgow's own page lists the equal consideration date undated as '14 January', which was the 2026-entry date. UCAS - which operates the deadline - publishes 13 January 2027 for 2027 entry on a page explicitly dated to that cycle. Resolved in favour of UCAS as the owning authority, NOT by inferring that Glasgow's page is stale. The Glasgow row is retained unchanged as the record of what Glasgow published.

Page section is explicitly headed 'How to apply for 2027 entry'. Oxford's own text gives no YEAR for 15 October; the year 2026 is established by UCAS's own separately-dated 2027-entry page, i.e. corroborated by a second official source rather than inferred.
